Briefing

Round 1 — Disposition for each pilot

Classify each of the eleven inherited pilots. Kill, Scale, Re-scope, or Hold. The Audit Committee asked for an operating model, not a status report — equivocation is not an available option.

Round 2 — Agent-vs-Human Matrix

For each HR work category, choose Agent-led, Agent-augmented, or Human-only. Lockouts must be defensible. Don Eugenio will read one page.

Round 3 — Architecture & Change Plan

Commit the vendor architecture, the internal-build envelope, and the change-management plan that names what dissolves, what reskills, what is created.
